title: Case Study B: Ethiopian Highlands Catastrophic Mudslide
subtitle: Vegetated Slope Creep & Rainfall Trigger Inverted to Failure Countdown
region: Kencho Shacha, Geze Gofa Woreda, Southern Ethiopia
hazard_type: Hydro-Geological Debris Flow / Deep-Seated Rotational Slide
recommended_radar_reason: Dense tropical canopy causes severe C-band decorrelation (γ < 0.25); L-Band (24 cm) penetrates canopy to maintain γ > 0.75

failure_forecast.window_text: Slope stable: creep within seasonal elastic limit

timeline_weeks.narrative: Sub-centimeter downslope creep on 32° terraced slope. C-band radar completely decorrelated due to coffee and banana tree canopy. L-band maintains strong interferometric phase.

failure_forecast.window_text: Accelerated creep observed; monitoring tertiary strain threshold

timeline_weeks.narrative: Kiremt monsoon rains begin infiltrating volcanic clay soil. Tensile crown cracks begin opening above Kencho Shacha village.
timeline_weeks.action: Field verification of tension cracks; task weekly L-band interferograms.

timeline_weeks.narrative: Inverse velocity 1/v curve demonstrates clear linear descent. Basal shear zone softening due to elevated pore-water pressure.
timeline_weeks.action: Issue ORANGE SLIDE WATCH to Gofa Zonal Disaster Risk Management Office.

failure_forecast.window_text: CRITICAL: Estimated slope failure window: 6–8 days (July 20–22, 2024)

timeline_weeks.narrative: Severe pore-water overpressure. SMAP soil saturation exceeds critical 85% threshold. Displacement velocity increases 300% in 14 days.
timeline_weeks.action: ORDER PREEMPTIVE EVACUATION: Relocate all households in Kencho Shacha valley floor.

failure_forecast.window_text: IMMINENT COLLAPSE: Estimated slope failure window: 12–24 hours

timeline_weeks.narrative: Inverse velocity 1/v asymptotically hits zero. Mass fluidization of wet clayey-silty hillslope occurs, releasing massive rotational debris flow.
timeline_weeks.action: RED CRITICAL DISASTER RESPONSE: Emergency rescue mobilization, cordoning debris zone.

impact_metrics.local_health_post: Kencho Shacha Health Post (Directly in Runout Path)
